intro: に加えて (from 加える, "add") stacks one more thing on top of something already there: "on top of X, Y as well". X is the base, Y is piled on, and Y usually carries も. Both sides point the same way; nothing is compared, contrasted or replaced.

skills.rule: X に加えて Y も = "in addition to X, Y as well": X stays and Y is added on top.
skills.explain:
に加えて follows a noun: 雨に加えて風も強くなった. A clause must first be turned into a noun with こと or の: 値段が安いことに加えて、味もいい. At the start of a sentence, それに加えて means "on top of that", and 加えて alone means "moreover".

The Y side normally has も, because it joins X rather than replacing it. X and Y are the same kind of thing (two costs, two problems, two skills) and push in the same direction. This is accumulation only.

The formal connective is に加え: 基本給に加え、交通費も支給されます. に加えて is neutral to formal; in casual talk people more often say だけじゃなくて or それに, and に加えて can sound like a news report.

examples.jp: 雨[あめ]{に加[くわ]えて}風[かぜ]も強[つよ]くなってきた。
examples.en: On top of the rain, the wind has picked up too.

examples.jp: 英語[えいご]{に加[くわ]えて}、中国語[ちゅうごくご]も話[はな]せる人[ひと]を探[さが]しています。
examples.en: We are looking for someone who speaks Chinese in addition to English.

examples.jp: 授業料[じゅぎょうりょう]{に加[くわ]えて}、教科書代[きょうかしょだい]もかかる。
examples.en: On top of tuition, you also have to pay for textbooks.

examples.jp: この店[みせ]は値段[ねだん]が安[やす]いこと{に加[くわ]えて}、味[あじ]もいい。
examples.en: Besides being cheap, this restaurant's food is good too.

examples.jp: 基本給[きほんきゅう]{にくわえ}、交通費[こうつうひ]も支給[しきゅう]されます。
examples.en: Transport costs are paid in addition to the base salary.

contrast.note: に比べて compares: 去年に比べて暑い, "hotter than last year". に加えて adds: 暑さに加えて湿気もある, "humidity on top of the heat".
に対して points at a target or sets up a contrast: 兄が背が高いのに対して、弟は低い. に加えて never contrasts; both sides pile up.
にかわって means "in place of": X is removed and Y takes its spot. に加えて keeps X and adds Y.

mistakes.bad: 去年[きょねん]{に加[くわ]えて}、今年[ことし]は雪[ゆき]が多[おお]い。
mistakes.good: 去年[きょねん]{に比[くら]べて}、今年[ことし]は雪[ゆき]が多[おお]い。
mistakes.note: "More snow than last year" is a comparison, so it needs に比べて.

mistakes.bad: この店[みせ]は安[やす]い{に加[くわ]えて}、静[しず]かだ。
mistakes.good: この店[みせ]は安[やす]いこと{に加[くわ]えて}、静[しず]かだ。
mistakes.note: に加えて follows a noun; turn the clause into one with こと or の first.

skills.tip: If English "plus" fits, use に加えて. "Than" means に比べて; "instead of" means にかわって.
